title: Yellowed Crisp Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A quick and easy Mediterranean dish featuring lamb, oregano, and a crispy exterior, served in a lacquerware bowl. This recipe is gluten-free friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Knead the lamb pieces with your hands for about 5 minutes to help break down the fibers and create a more tender texture.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the lamb is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with dried oregano.
Serve the lamb kebabs in a lacquerware bowl and enjoy.
